# Ultraterrestrial Resurrection – Pre-Deletion State Rule

## Overview

This rule summarizes the **core features, architecture, and technical state** of the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project as it existed before the repository was deleted. It is intended to provide historical context for future recovery, refactoring, or onboarding efforts.

---

## 1. Core System Components

- **Xata Database Integration**
  - Client setup, CRUD operations, and search capabilities.
- **Next.js Framework**
  - Modern React application with Tailwind CSS for styling.
- **Storybook**
  - UI component development and testing system.

---

## 2. Major Features

### Mind Map System
- Interactive node-based visualization using ReactFlow.
- AI-enhanced node management for research connections.
- Command interface for mind map interaction.
- Recent focus: refactoring and type improvements.

### 3D Visualization
- Interactive globe for visualizing UFO sightings.
- Three.js integration for 3D rendering.
- Animated time series display for sightings.
- Custom WebGL components.

### AI Integration
- OpenAI API for chat and assistants.
- Claude AI for content extraction and analysis.
- Firecrawl web scraping tool (planned).
- Exa SDK for documentation research.
- Processing pipelines for documents and web content.

### Disclosure RAG System
- Python-based analysis tools for UFO/UAP content.
- Specialized research agents for different tasks.
- Knowledge base with vector storage.
- Agent orchestration framework.

### Data Pipeline CLI
- Command-line interface for data processing.
- Data import/export functionality.
- Bucket-based workflow system.
- Status report indicated this was in active development.

### UI Components
- Card systems and specialized layouts.
- Navigation components and sidebars.
- Scientific visualization interfaces.
- Custom icon system.

---

## 3. Recent Development Focus

- Mind map refactoring and type improvements.
- Database provider registry system.
- Data pipeline CLI enhancements.
- Web extraction and processing improvements.

---

## 4. Technical Debt & Gaps (as of last status)

- **AI Enhancement**: Disabled pending API key acquisition.
- **Automated Tests & CI**: Not implemented; needs coverage and pipeline setup.
- **Import Workflow**: Beta; requires schema tuning and larger dataset testing.
- **Documentation**: Partial; per-command docs and architecture docs still needed.
- **Firecrawl Integration**: Scaffold present, not yet integrated.

---

## 5. Recommendations for Future Work

- Re-enable and integrate AI enhancement modules.
- Implement automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.
- Harden import workflows and expand regression datasets.
- Complete documentation, especially for CLI and data pipeline.
- Integrate Firecrawl for remote source discovery.

---

## 6. References

- [repository-features-before-deletion.md](mdc:recovery/repository-features-before-deletion.md)
- [apps/cli/STATUS.md](mdc:apps/cli/STATUS.md)
- [Documentation/DataPipelineCliPRD.md](mdc:Documentation/DataPipelineCliPRD.md)
- [Documentation/DataPipelineCliDocs_PSEUDOCODE.md](mdc:Documentation/DataPipelineCliDocs_PSEUDOCODE.md)
- [apps/cli/CLI_APP_PRD.md](mdc:apps/cli/CLI_APP_PRD.md)

---

## 7. Rule Usage

- Use this rule to understand the **historical baseline** of the project.
- Reference when planning recovery, refactoring, or onboarding new contributors.
- Update or supersede this rule as the project is rebuilt or new features are added.

---
